newsitem.title: IRAN: Three Indian navy vessels visit Iranian Gulf port.
newsitem.headline: Three Indian navy vessels visit Iranian Gulf port.

text.p: Three Indian naval vessels arrived on Monday in an Iranian Gulf port on a visit aimed at boosting cooperation between the two countries' navies.
The ships docked at Bandar Abbas, Iran's main Gulf port, for the four-day visit, the Iranian news agency IRNA said.
The crew of the Indian vessels will visit industrial plants affiliated with the Iranian navy, port facilities and Iran's free trade zone on Qeshm island, the agency added.
Iranian media earlier said the visit aimed at developing technical cooperation between the two navies.

Iran has been improving ties with India, Pakistan's arch-foe, as relations between Tehran and Islamabad have cooled. Iran accuses Pakistan of interfering in neighbouring Afghanistan. Pakistan denies the accusation.
